**Round 441 passes**, with no bugs found. I used a real browser at 1440×900 and 1280×720, so `browserVerified` is true.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| Source scope (start and end) | Only the 7 granted paths changed. The frozen and protected manifests both check clean. |
| Patch identity | The 6 changed files match the sketch applied to a fresh copy of HEAD. |
| Covering tests | 12 files, 267 of 267 pass. |
| Mutants | The 30 result lines match B's `results.jsonl` exactly. |
| Sweep | K7, K8 and K9 are 0, K10 is `4 testids 6`, and the K24 hook sweep lists the component plus the four test files that use the new hooks. |
| Overview hooks and pixels | The hooks checker prints ALL OK. All 4 Overview shots show 0 px difference against HEAD rendered in the same job. Full-window shots differ by 10 px at 1440 and 2 px at 1280, which is record-only noise. |
| Auth | `auth_user` is null, the studio page shows "Sign in required" with 0 `audio[src]`, and the token API returns 401. Premium auth is not bypassed. |
| Play | It goes from "Loading" to ready, and the second press plays at both viewports. The clock reads 1.46 s and 1.47 s. |
| Export | `czaba-studio-lab.wav`, 29,189,420 bytes, `RIFF`…`WAVE`, at both viewports. The button returns to "Export WAV". |
| Claims | The claims diff equals the expected diff. |
| Doc 287 | The TEMPLATE headings are in order and line 4 is exact. It cites every mutant id, S2-R1/2/3 and both TODO items. |

- **Blocked:** the fake-bearer token check, because the backend is unavailable in the cloud.
- **Limits:** the export probe checks only the WAV header and size. I did not measure samples or duration. My first auth probe attempt timed out on a cold start, and the retry passed.
- **For B:** A's code-reviewer raised a Low that nobody has ruled on (`A-R441-REVIEW-L1-OUTLINE-ORDER`). The `panel-radius-ui` and `content-colour-ui` tests no longer pin that the outline comes before the lanes. No mutant covers it.
- **Not run by C:** full vitest, typecheck, build, Biome and verify, which are gate rows.

I did not edit any app source. The L57 checker passes on the JSON.
